months.note: 봄 이동기에 서해와 남서해 섬에 드물게 들르며 5월 기록이 가장 많다. 국내에서 기록된 달이다.

summary: 긴 목과 길고 노란 부리를 지닌 몸집 큰 새로, 갈대밭이나 나무 위에 둥지를 틀고 알 3~5개를 낳는다. 숨어 지내는 습성과 사는 환경 때문에 보기 어려울 수 있지만, 날아가는 모습은 종종 눈에 띈다. 곤충과 물고기, 양서류를 먹는다. 열대 지방에서 번식하며 유럽, 아시아, 인도, 스리랑카 동부, 중국, 인도네시아, 오스트레일리아에 분포한다.

sexes.male: 몸 윗면과 날개가 검은빛 도는 짙은 잿빛이고, 목 옆에 노란 줄이 있으며 흰 멱과 가슴에 짙은 세로줄이 빽빽하다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 몸 윗면이 갈색을 띠고 조금 옅으며, 가슴의 세로줄에 붉은 밤색이 섞인다.

young: 어린새는 어른새와 비슷한 색이지만 어두운 갈색을 띤다.

art.subject: Black Bittern (Ixobrychus flavicollis), adult male: crown, hindneck, back, wings and tail uniform slaty black; a broad buff-yellow to orange-buff stripe from below the eye down the side of the neck; chin, throat and foreneck white and buff, densely striped chestnut-brown and black down the centre, the stripes continuing onto the breast; lower underparts dark sooty grey-black; bill long and dagger-like, dark horn-grey, the lower mandible paler and yellowish towards the base; legs dark brown to blackish.
art.pose: flying low over a reed bed
art.scene: Korean marsh: dense reed bed with a few trees along its edge; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing among reeds: uniformly slaty-black crown, back, wings and tail, broad buff-yellow neck stripe, white-and-buff foreneck heavily striped chestnut and black, dark lower underparts, long dark horn dagger bill with a paler yellowish base below
juvenile, side view standing: same pattern as the adult but dark brown instead of black, with the buff neck stripe and streaked foreneck
art.build: Medium-sized, slender bittern, 58cm, much larger than Yellow and Cinnamon Bitterns and about the length of a Black-crowned Night Heron but slimmer, with a long neck and a small head; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat. Bill long, straight and dagger-shaped, about as long as the head or slightly longer, dark horn-grey with a paler yellowish base below. Legs medium length, dark brown to blackish. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip; tail very short. In flight looks all dark above, the neck usually drawn in and the buff neck stripe showing; wings rather broad and uniformly blackish.
avoid: Do not paint buff wing coverts with black flight feathers (Yellow Bittern) or rufous wings (Cinnamon Bittern); the whole wing is sooty black.
Do not omit the buff-yellow stripe down the side of the neck.
Do not paint a bright yellow bill; it is dark horn-grey with only a paler yellowish base to the lower mandible.
Do not paint a short thick bill or a stocky short neck like a night heron.
Do not paint the whole underside white; only the throat, foreneck and breast are pale and heavily streaked.

white foreneck and breast densely streaked chestnut and black
